quarterly_data.quarter: Kingboard Laminates HKEX announcement: Joint Announcement - Revision of Annual Caps (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: On 9 September 2026 Kingboard Laminates and Hallgain Management Limited (controlling shareholder of parent Kingboard Holdings; the Hallgain Group makes electronic component parts, raw materials and machineries for laminate and PCB production) renewed two framework agreements to 31 December 2028. Supply of copper and laminates to the Hallgain Group: annual cap for 2026 revised from HK$597,000 thousand to HK$829,630 thousand, with caps of HK$912,593 thousand (2027) and HK$1,003,852 thousand (2028); actual sales were HK$421,113 thousand (2024), HK$474,678 thousand (2025) and HK$460,905 thousand (to 31 August 2026), estimated HK$691,358 thousand for 2026. Purchase of machineries for laminate production from the Hallgain Group (term 2027-2028): caps HK$343,200 thousand (2027) and HK$446,160 thousand (2028); actual purchases HK$83,841 thousand (2024), HK$240,644 thousand (2025) and HK$150,721 thousand (to 31 August 2026). Caps are ceilings, not sales; the companies cite anticipated demand growth and higher market prices.
